blockers: Coverage is blocked, not certified: all 21,190 native frames were decoded and all 708 integer-second frames visually inspected. The 228 change samples and native tracking measurements are retained, but complete corresponding physical camera/pose coverage has not passed the original 38.4 px held-out gate. Some first/last-visible transition boundaries remain unrefined.

Top-down cone replay 413.646567..420.2 s: measured post heads move while pedestal and foot features remain fixed. The earlier t414 rest-camera trial was invalid because its fitted post anchors move with the cone. It is not evidence of a native-geometry defect or physical impossibility. Camera and actual cone rigid pose must be calibrated jointly; anchorPoseMissing prevents rest-pose fitting.

Measuring-stick movement 42.1421..74.7 s: native stick and stop geometry exist. Actual stop targets 5 and 10 and front bar movement are observed, but the stop-contact datum, world pose and exact physical station mapping through hand occlusion remain uncalibrated. Do not invent the other nineteen amplitude values.

Gearing disassembly 170..230.8 s: actual pin/handle withdrawal, nut removal, carrier swing, chain removal, T18-to-T12/T24 replacement and reassembly are included. All native rigid parts and 66 chain links exist. Source rigid-part poses and visible loose-chain correspondence remain unmapped; the gearing enum alone does not reproduce this operation. Tooth-collision dynamics are not claimed or required here.

Simultaneous physical views require independent cameras and checks: three platen/pen views at 241..285.35 s; fixture/pen views at 348..363.63 and 375..381.25 s; machine/wheel at 364.4..374.174 s; withdrawal/wheel at 568.002..571.538 s. The fixture/pen divider is measured at source columns 992..1023, not guessed as two 960 px halves. World-pose and camera coverage remain blocked.

Independent cylinder setup at 421.3..430.8 s and accelerated alignment at 445.912..457.4904 s require twenty independent phase histories. Hands obscure changing notch/rod identities. Later common side/top notch orientations are observed, but hidden intermediate phase values are not assigned.

Cone replay movement 413.880133..414.947867 s and pinion setup 468.6348..487.754 s: actual visible movement and native feature pixels are retained. Numerical coneSwingRad and pinionCamRad require calibrated source geometry rather than narration interpolation or assumed endpoint values.

Pen withdrawal/assembly 565.3..597.964 s and pen yaw 611..649.3153 s: native rod, hanger, V-block, frame, marker and set-screw geometry exist. Relative source part poses and wire coupling through hand occlusion remain unmapped. These physical parts do not receive a non-machine HOLD exemption.

Static camera positive controls at 95, 96 and 99 s pass six fit and seven independent check anchors with held-out maximum 32.758003 px. Twenty-channel amplitude/phase/crank/spring/fixture inputs remain uncalibrated: these three camera passes are not full-pose or whole-video certification.

Ruler calibration requires resolution, not a false domain conclusion: source t74 physically reaches target 10 and the authoritative native stick pitch is 14.2 mm (142 mm from 0 to 10). Current mechanics normalizes to plus/minus 88 mm. Only if the actual stop-contact and zero-axis datum correspond directly would target 10 imply 142/88 = 1.613636; the datum and physical linkage/spring feasibility are not established. No silent clamp, unit remapping or fabricated coefficient is permitted.
